title: XamlGen Scaffold Output
description: Output of the scaffold step. Describes what a specific activity requires. The caller reads the argument and slot descriptors and constructs an ActivityNode for the generate input.

activityId.description: Activity identifier as provided in the scaffold input. Echoed for traceability.

fullName.description: CLR fully-qualified type name (from catalog activity.fullName).

description.description: Activity description from the catalog. null if not provided.

arguments.description: Argument descriptors (catalog members with memberKind 'argument'). The caller uses name as the key and supplies an expression string (In/InOut) or variable name (Out) in the generate input ActivityNode.arguments object.

slots.description: Structural child slot descriptors (catalog members with memberKind 'child'). The caller uses name as the key in the generate input ActivityNode.slots object and supplies a Node.

name.description: CLR property name. Use as the key in the generate input ActivityNode.arguments object.

direction.description: Argument direction. In/InOut: supply an expression string in the generate input. Out: supply a variable name to bind the output to.

dataType.description: CLR type name of the argument (from catalog member.dataType).

required.description: Whether this argument must be supplied in the generate input.

defaultValue.description: Default value as an expression string, as it would appear in the generate input. null if the catalog does not define a default.

enumValues.description: Valid values when dataType is an enum, expressed as 'EnumTypeName.MemberName'. null for non-enum types.

name.description: CLR property name. Use as the key in the generate input ActivityNode.slots object.

required.description: Whether this slot must be supplied in the generate input.

description.description: Slot description from the catalog. null if not provided.
